name: EPIC 220746858
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 9.9 solar radii and 0.90 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 2,337 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.90 solar masses and 9.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,916 K at its surface.
